name: Call of Earth

angles.text: As a shaman, you take part in an essential communion that binds spirit to stone and grants vision beyond mortal perception through sapta’s ritual draught.
As a dwarf, you hear this sacred communion in the rough cadence of your people, amid frozen mountain peaks. It ties communion with the earth to Dun Morogh’s snowy heights.
As an Alliance member, you see an elemental rite practiced among snowy mountain crags, where shamanic traditions take root within Alliance lands.

faq.answer: Earth Sapta is a potent mystical brew crafted with magic to bind a practitioner’s spirit directly to the elements. It is not meant for the weak-willed. Drinking it pierces ordinary mortal sight, revealing spirits and elemental truths others cannot perceive.
You must drink the brew only at a dedicated sacred site. For this rite, you travel north up the mountain along a hidden path to find the ancient Spirit Stone among the crags.
faq.q: Where must the sapta be consumed?

faq.answer: The rite is a foundational trial of communion and humility. At the Spirit Stone, drinking sapta teaches you to draw strength from the mountains and patience from the plains. It attunes your mortal spirit to the living world before you face more turbulent elements.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the Call of Earth rite?

faq.answer: Only a select few initiated shamans know how to brew sapta. Brewing it requires knowledge and spiritual preparation. Its recipe is guarded with great reverence because the draught connects mortal awareness directly to primal forces.
faq.q: Who knows how to brew Earth Sapta?

aliases: how does earth compare to fire water air
faq.answer: Other elemental forces clash, burn, and roar with violent unrest, while earth brings steadfast stillness, patience, and an unyielding foundation. You first learn humility before stone, then face the volatile dual nature of the other elements.
faq.q: How does the element of earth differ from the other elements?

aliases: where is call of earth set
faq.answer: The rite takes place high in a cold, snowbound mountain range. You follow a secluded path through snow and stone to commune with the spirits of the land despite the biting frost.
faq.q: What setting is this rite performed in?

sections.body: At an isolated mountain shrine, you drink Earth Sapta, an enchanted brew. Ancient elemental magic gives it power to show mortal eyes elemental spirits and subtle currents beyond ordinary sight. Its strength makes the shrine the only safe place to drink it, where spirit and stone can form their bond.
sections.title: The Draught of Vision

sections.body: High on a snow-swept mountain, the Spirit Stone waits at the end of a secluded path. You travel through bitter cold to stand humbly before the ancient rock. The living earth welcomes those who come without pride. Mountains give lasting physical strength, while the vast, steady plains teach patience.
sections.title: The Spirit Stone in the Snow

sections.body: Communion with stone is a foundational rite for spiritual pathfinders. Wind, fire, and crashing water carry restless fury, while earth teaches discipline and quiet resilience. You absorb earth's still essence, preparing mind and body for the conflicting, chaotic dualities of the more volatile elements that roar across the world.
sections.title: Strength and Stillness

summary: At a mountain Spirit Stone, an initiate drinks Earth Sapta and binds spirit to the world's enduring foundations. The draught opens the way to elemental awareness, teaching humility and patience amid snow and rock.
attribution: In-game quest text: Call of Earth
